summary: Reference entry for the ansible.module_utils.basic module, imported in custom modules.
questions: How do I use the basic module_utils in my module?

answer_card.title: Importing module_utils.basic
answer_card.answer_md: Include `import ansible.module_utils.basic` in your module to use the functions in `ansible.module_utils.basic`.
